'1 enemy unit(s) with the highest remaining HP' resolves to the sole boss; the ranking clause is untestable in v1 and moves no damage.

The unit's whole offense depends on the self targetMaxHpPct grants feeding atkOfMaxHpPct (legal only because caster===target). If the engine does not re-read live Max HP for that conversion, S1 is silently inert and the unit is under-modeled — verify the feed path before trusting any total.

noFb is unset on every damage line (FB-by-timing default ON). The burst-cast hits are expected FB-exempt by cast timing (burst damage lands before the FB window opens), which is engine timing, not a per-kit flag.
noRange is left to the engine (automatic on riders); hasPierce not set — the kit carries no Pierce line.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. 2B (2b), AR/Fire/Defender/Burst III, cd 40s, ammo 90 — an HP→ATK converter with no team-facing effects. S1: burst-cast (own-burst) escalating self Max HP ladder, 10.03% → +20.06% → +57.76%, cumulative per the 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' clause (87.85% total after her 3rd own cast), 'continuously' = no expiry. S2b: passive from battle start, ATK ▲ 6.16% of her OWN final Max HP (atkOfMaxHpPct) — this is the sole channel through which S1 produces damage. S2a: cumulative-300-rounds-fired rider, 167.45% of final ATK to the enemy (hitCount trigger; 'firing N times' counts rounds, not trigger pulls). Burst: two enemy hits resolved on cast — 2439.36% distributed + 792% additional. No weapon swap, no stacks/resources, no pierce, no Hit Rate, no heal/shield/DEF line, no ally-targeted effect; every effect is self- or enemy-scoped, so this unit contributes nothing to a teammate's buffs. All kit lines are implemented — unmodeled is empty by audit, not by omission.
